dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, dark-intensity asymmetrical clusters located on the mid-lateral flank, characterized by solid pixel saturation lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle, while the lateral high-intensity blobs are arranged in an irregular, dense cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced linear specular highlight along the lower lateral boundary resulting in a localized band of peak-intensity white pixels.
